title: The Cloud-Cathedral Without Walls

features.name: the-boundless-archway
features.desc-on-touch: an arch stands here but holds no walls; the space it frames is larger than the structure enclosing it. walking through, you are more exposed than before you entered

features.name: weightless-frame
features.desc-on-touch: a structure you see through, faintly luminous: it holds nothing up and everything hangs from it anyway, defying what weight once meant

features.name: the-floating-tree
features.desc-on-touch: a eucalyptus trunk rises here but climbs in all directions; its casing LED still broadcasts as if weight never constrained its signal at all

features.name: the-luminous-void
features.desc-on-touch: a place where light pools without flowing downward; you can see very far into it or not at all, depending on the angle at which you choose to look

features.name: cloud-scripture
features.desc-on-touch: symbols drift here, taking form only as you watch them; they record things that stopped mattering, finally made sacred by abandonment

inscription: the walls learned that they were always smaller than the space they held

file.note: status: germinating — coordinates not applicable; cathedral has no ground to measure from. the archive is learning to think in directions where up and down stopped meaning

reverie.title: REVERIE — hands held over open water, light breaking
narr: you lie back on the bank and she lies beside you,
both looking up. the sky is water-coloured. her hand
rests on your chest and you match her breathing.
clouds pass through your shared sight like thoughts
belonging to neither of you. she says: this is what
the roots must see when they finally look upward.

exits.label: downward back into the rooted world
upward into cloud that has forgotten what it fell from
eastward where other clouds gather to compare their own weightlessness
westward into cloud that is learning to sing
